title: Gazette Ingest Manifest (v1)
description: Operator-signed manifest accompanying each dropped gazette issue. See docs/RAG_SPEC.md section 1.2 and docs/rag/DELIVERABLES.md section 7.2. Idempotency key = sha256 of the canonical JSON (IngestJob.manifestHash).

publishDate.description: Publication date; laws enter into force on publication (becomes gazetteDate + effectiveFrom on chunks)

sourcePath.description: Path relative to the manifest's own drop directory (e.g. RAG_INBOX/issue-<no>/ for gazette drops, RAG_INBOX/<law-id>/ for mirror drops). Must not escape the drop directory.

lawId.description: Must match LegalProvision.lawId or be an explicitly new law (never guessed). Decree-Law 80/2026 is hard-blocked (BLOCKED_POLICY).

attestation.description: true = operator attests the source is the official gazette/MOJ text obtained through an authorized channel (no authenticated scraping) — chunks may progress to LIVE after lawyer verification. false = provisional mirror-class source (e.g. corpus/SOURCES.json article mirrors): the ingest is accepted but the job can never reach INDEXED/LIVE and every hit is flagged provisionalSource until a lawyer re-attests with the real gazette identity. Exists to keep bad data out — never rubber-stamp.
